# State Nationalist Reform

> Public website with separate Home, Mission, Funding/Trust, Standing, and Vault pages.

## Pages

- [Home](https://statenationalistreform.com/): Strategic briefing and links to the site's main sections.
- [Mission](https://statenationalistreform.com/mission.html): Strategic initiative overview.
- [Funding and Trust](https://statenationalistreform.com/funding-trust.html): Funding materials and asset-distribution visualization.
- [Standing](https://statenationalistreform.com/standing.html): Standing materials and jurisdictional flow visualization.
- [Vault](https://statenationalistreform.com/vault.html): Vault resource listings.
